lifetime_invariants: BUSY reserves exactly one queue insertion; queue insertion accesses only the immortal worker after publication
EXEC/LOOP own the callback; INLINE_QUEUED owns both inline RUN and a separate queued invocation
A queued worker meeting INLINE_QUEUED transfers pending work to inline unlock without executing concurrently
PARKED preserves disabled pending work; shared short state lock serializes parking, enable and running-state observation
No worker dereferences a tasklet after releasing its final running or parked ownership
State spin lock never surrounds callbacks, sleepable queue mutexes or taskqueue_enqueue
Caller must quiesce producers before tasklet_kill/free; disabled pending work must be enabled to drain, as required by Linux tasklet semantics
tasklet.limits: Kernel mutexes, atomics, intrusive queues and worker dispatch are host models; actual NMX taskqueue has its separate fixture. GPU IRQ, real scheduling/preemption and target cleanup remain unverified.
